context: Sakura ends an exhausting workday at a quiet bar with Yuki-office.
purpose: Two adult women decompressing over wine.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Quiet opening, no performance. Weary but steady exhale. The relief of admitting tiredness to someone who won't minimize it. Slight trailing-off.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Soft agreement. Warm without fussing. Settles in gently. A quiet permission for both of you to just be tired together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wonder in the delivery. Noticing something small and real. Slow pace, present. Not sad—just fully there with the moment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: Nights like this are exactly what we need sometimes.
lines.style: Reflective warmth. Speaking from experience. Unhurried. The kind of thing someone says who knows you well enough not to fill silences.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとう、来てくれて。
lines.style: Genuine and unguarded. Soft attack on the opening word. No flourish—just sincere. Slight pause before delivering the gratitude, like it took a breath to say it.
